label: Darwinian epistemic debunking finite controls
description: Nonvacuity and omission controls for the three arguments. Tracking failure does not entail actual inaccuracy; one omission example shows origin fixing is needed; the self-application premises are jointly satisfiable and leave the conclusion true and F6 intact; a no-undercutting model with history-fixed correctness satisfies the same uniform policy and keeps warrant, which shows consistency, not that antirealism specifically secures warrant. These are formal interpretations only; no actual history, reliability or account of epistemic correctness is established.
